objective: net capital gain from closing a held positive-EMA asset versus the unchanged baseline EMA rebalance
engineering_amendments_before_training: Hold in the historical adapter means unchanged R1_EMA_4h rebalance, not fixed units. Initial action cost is the actual direct delta, never baseline buy followed by an artificial sell.
Labels use fully joint portfolio branches and one shared cash balance. Removal can require risk rescaling of other assets.
The common endpoint is the full reference portfolio at H, including its causal EMA target changes. Both branches pay their actual transition to the same jointly cash-feasible units.

Expanding net-label training starts May 2026 because earlier funding is unavailable; no zero-rate fabrication. Price/risk history remains from 2022. Disconnected funding-covered reference segments are explicit, not a rolling-window substitution.

label_reference_segments.reason: complete funding until the subsequent documented gap; last state is not an artificial liquidation
continuous research replay; terminal liquidation is part of this fixed interval

funding_coverage: all eight symbols at every UTC 00/08/16 settlement inside each segment; missing input aborts stage
availability_rule: label H plus 2250000 us <= origin minus seven 4h bars

model.target: paired net delta bps of current held asset reference notional

policy_rule: for held positive-EMA assets close if predicted net gain > 0; flat-to-positive EMA entries unchanged; mandatory exits/risk limits override
constant_control: mean matured train-only action label, refitted at same origins
causal_rule_control: predicted gain = negative last completed 4h return in bps minus fixed stress roundtrip 28 bps; no tuning
never_intervene_control: saved R1_EMA_4h, with engineering parity against the sequential adapter
execution: assumed completed close, fractional units, fees on executed notional, signed funding at reference closes; no observed-fill qualification

bootstrap.warning: not a complete global adaptive-testing adjustment or independent validation

success_review: net growth and drawdown/exposure/cost tradeoff first; paired and absolute primary/audit LCB assess robustness; no automatic promotion
training_after: synthetic checks, preregistration, reference/label provenance and fold/index hash sealing
